originalEntry.title: Sand animation of 100 years of Hong Kong

originalEntry.description: A 2-minute sand-animation-style story of a century of Hong Kong history with music and sound design, posted alongside a GPT-6 Astra version.

originalEntry.prompt: Make a 2-minute sand animation that tells the story of 100 years of Hong Kong history. Keep it lively, engaging, and tasteful. Add appropriate background music and sound design.
